task.title: Page finite recurrence inventory
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/983 with bounded exact-ID keyset paging over authoritative recurrence streams.
acceptance_criteria: Validate a positive at-most-1024 page size and return complete recurrences in exact-ID order.
Use an optional exclusive exact-ID cursor and expose continuation only after validating one lookahead stream.
Bound selection and replay to page size plus one while isolating corruption outside the selected window.

attempts.diagnostic: Paging tests failed because RecurrencePageSize, RecurrencePage, and RecurrenceStore::list_page did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added focused tests for bounds, ordering, continuation, nonexistent cursors, empty pages, read-only reopen, unrelated streams, and corruption windows.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded kernel slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented one ordered keyset query with a validated lookahead and canonical full-history projection for every selected stream.
attempts.patch: Implemented issue 983 in event_log.rs and scheduler.rs with focused store tests, ADR-0091, and scheduler documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found no blocking issues; a rate-limited false green was excluded until genuine CodeRabbit run 27d12662 completed on the exact head with no actionable comments and zero unresolved threads.
attempts.patch: Preserved the exact verified head through cooldown before enabling squash merge.

outcome.summary: Issue 983 delivered allocation-bounded recurrence inventory paging with fail-closed selected-window replay.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 984 exact head e4b1b6c97ea84d008986ba58a59944e3b1eeaa87

lessons: Exact-ID keyset paging provides stable continuation without persisted cursor state or positional drift.
The lookahead must be replayed and validated before it can prove continuation safely.
Status-filtered paging needs a separate sparse-scan or index contract; this boundary adds no mutation or execution authority.
